root_idea.summary: The root covers two closely associated lexical orientations: interposition or separation between things, and perishing or causing something to perish.
root_idea.development: The supplied evidence connects being held back or obstructed with perishing; the derived Form IV expresses causation, while مَوْبِق denotes an intervening separation and is also associated with perishing. An additional Classical use reports مَوْبِق for an appointed time.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested Form IV verb has a distinct causative lexical meaning.
The Quran-attested nominal has distinct lexical and constructional content as an intervening barrier associated with perishing.

senses.definition: To cause to perish; to destroy.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use: the subject causes another being or thing to perish.

senses.definition: An intervening barrier or separation between two things or parties.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic construction of something placed between two groups or parties to keep them apart.

senses.definition: Perishing or destruction resulting from being held back or obstructed.
senses.usage_conditions: A related nominal use connected with the root expression for being held back until one perishes; it explains the destructive nuance associated with the Quranic noun.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use; the supplied lexical discussion frames the perishing as occurring after being held back or checked.
A reported Classical use of the noun, distinct from its Quran-attested sense of an intervening barrier.

cautions: No Lane primary source units were supplied for this root; the broader Classical coverage is therefore limited to meanings directly supported by the supplied Maqayis and Mufradat evidence.
